hero.subtitle: Rwanda's premier technology event. Partner with ICT Chamber to connect, inspire, and accelerate innovation across the continent.

about.paragraph1: Digital Transformation Week (DTW) 2026 is Rwanda's most impactful technology event, convening government leaders, tech innovators, investors, and development partners to accelerate Rwanda's digital transformation agenda.
about.paragraph2: Organized by the ICT Chamber under the Rwanda Private Sector Federation, in partnership with MINICT and RISA, DTW2026 will showcase Rwanda's growing position as a continental technology hub.
bullets: Flagship conferences, masterclasses and panel discussions
Investor connect and startup pitching sessions
Government and private sector policy dialogues
